verdict.rationale: Unity documents building one project for different platforms through per-platform build profiles, claims support for 25+ platforms, and offers Build Automation for simultaneous multiplatform builds including iOS. A community comment independently confirms Unity's strength as a cross-platform engine that targets iOS, and WebGL export is also documented. missing for 10: explicit evidence naming console targets (directly or via partner programs), explicit naming of desktop OS targets (Windows/macOS/Linux), and hands-on corroboration of console export.
